notes.title: [AshBall DevLog #2] Matchmaking System and Improvements
notes.content:
[h1]⚡ Quick Match: Getting into the game is now easier than ever!🔥[/h1]

This week I’ve added a brand-new feature to get you into matches faster: the [b]Matchmaking System[/b].  
The game will first scan for available sessions; if it can’t find one, it will automatically create a new session for you. All you need to do is press the [u]Start[/u] button — the system takes care of the rest.  
Faster matches, more chaos.


[b]Other improvements in this update:[/b]

[list]
[*]Improved connection stability ⚡[/*]
[*]Performance improvements and small optimizations 🛠️[/*]
[*]Several bug fixes and balance tweaks 🔧[/*]
[/list]
I’m still working to make the game more fun, intense, and unpredictable than what you saw in the trailer.  
Weekly updates will continue to bring small but impactful changes.


[b]Thanks for your interest and patience — we’re just getting started![/b]

And yes I still need an artist. Please contact me 😭😭 ( 8kyaoo@gmail.com )

notes.title: [AshBall DevLog #1 There is a Spirit in the Menu – UI Update & Minor Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]🔧 A Small Touch: The Menu Feels More Alive! 🔥[/h2]

[i]Hello there![/i]



Lately, I've been working on Blender, UI animation, and post-processing in Unity.

I've slowly started integrating what I learn into [b]AshBall[/b].



[b]In this update:[/b]

[list]
  [*]The menu title now has a [b]typewriter animation[/b] (with an actual [i]typewriter sound[/i] while typing 🖋️🎹)[/*]
  [*]The [b]Leaderboard button[/b] is now animated with a small "fire" effect that fits the lava theme[/*]
  [*]Some old UI elements were simplified for a [b]cleaner and more balanced look[/b][/*]
  [*][b]Post-processing adjustments[/b] were made for better tone harmony in the background[/*]
  [*]A rare [b]synchronization bug[/b] related to ball sharing was fixed[/*]
[/list]

[i]These may be small, but they add soul.[/i]

AshBall is still alive, learning, and growing 🍂🔥



[b]Thanks![/b]
